sloka: नयेङ्गितज्ञः सद्वृत्तो दक्षो धैर्यसमन्वितः ।स रामं दृश्य सहसा पूर्णचन्द्रसमप्रभम् ।। ७.१.१० ॥
transliteration: nayeṅgitajñaḥ sadvṛtto dakṣo dhairyasamanvitaḥ ।sa rāmaṁ dṛśya sahasā pūrṇacandrasamaprabham ।। 7.1.10 ॥

translations.english: He, who was skilled in policy and gestures, of good conduct, efficient, and endowed with courage, immediately saw Rama, who shone like the full moon.
